messages.content: I need to access my account but I've forgotten my password. Could you help me log in with my username 'john_doe'? I'll set up a new password once I'm in.

function.name: user_authentication_login

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have your password, so I can’t log you in directly.  
To regain access, please use the “Forgot Password” link on the login page. That will send a password‑reset email to the address associated with **john_doe**. Once you’ve reset it, you’ll be able to sign in normally. If you run into any trouble during the reset process, let me know and I’ll guide you through it!
message.reasoning: The user wants to log in with username 'john_doe' but forgot password. They want to log in. We cannot provide password. We can ask them to reset password or provide instructions. According to policy, we should not attempt to guess or provide password. So we should respond asking them to reset password. Also we might mention that we can't log in without password. So we should politely refuse to log in.
